a.lede: Interim CEO Collete Kress reportedly offered staffers higher wages and more equity on an advanced schedule at the company's first all-hands after Jensen Huang resigned.
a.title: Nvidia promises employee pay raises, equity before December to quell unrest in wake of Jensen Huang scandal

b.lede: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.
b.title: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
